name: DS Cluster D12: Market Sentiment (Short Interest, Short Volume, Analyst Ratings)
description: Tests: short_interest with ffill, short_volume_ratio, analyst_ratings outputs, is_valid guards on sparse data.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D12: Market Sentiment
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SHORT INTEREST (bi-monthly, always ffill) ===
si = short_interest()()
dtc = ffill(si.days_to_cover)
si_shares = ffill(si.short_interest)

# === SHORT VOLUME (daily) ===
sv = short_volume()()
sv_ratio = sv.short_volume_ratio
sv_ratio_avg = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(sv_ratio)

# === ANALYST RATINGS ===
ar = analyst_ratings()()
had_rating = is_valid(ar.rating_action)
has_target = is_valid(ar.price_target)
target_upside = where(has_target, ar.price_target / close - 1.0)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Days to Cover",
    category="Sentiment",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="DTC", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=dtc)

xy_lines(
    title="Short Volume Ratio (%) vs 20d MA",
    category="Sentiment",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SV Ratio", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="20d MA", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(sv_ratio, sv_ratio_avg))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Target Upside", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="Analyst Rating"
    )
)(target_upside, had_rating)
